q: What is the 5th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
exp: A=1, B=2, C=3, D=4, E=5. Answer: E

q: What is the position of the letter M in the English alphabet?
Which letter is 8th from the right end (Z=1 from right)?
What is the 10th letter from the left?
exp: J is the 10th letter. Answer: J

q: Which letter is exactly in the middle of D and N?
exp: D=4, N=14; middle = (4+14)/2 = 9 = I. Answer: I

q: If the alphabet is written backwards, what is the 6th letter from the left?
exp: Backwards: Z=1, Y=2, X=3, W=4, V=5, U=6. Answer: U

q: What is the sum of positions of the letters in the word CAT?
Which letter is 3rd to the right of J?
What is the position of the letter that is exactly midway between A and Z?
If the letters of the word TABLE are written in reverse order, what is the new first letter?
exp: TABLE reversed = ELBAT; first letter = E. Answer: E

q: Which letter is 5th from the right end?
exp: Z=1, Y=2, X=3, W=4, T=5. Answer: T

q: What is the 7th letter to the left of Q?
How many letters are there between P and X (excluding both)?
What is the 4th letter after the letter that is 2nd before M?
exp: 2nd before M(13) = K(11); 4th after K = O(15). Answer: O

q: If the alphabet is written in reverse order starting from Z, which letter will be at the 10th position?
exp: Z=1, Y=2, ..., position 10 = R. Answer: R
